A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CPCP research work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C support a complete comparison despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: v4 reports original evaluations on eight regression benchmarks, including coverage diagnostics, prediction-set volumes, and ablations in Section 6 and Appendix A.5.

after.justification: v5 retains these original benchmark evaluations and ablations in Section 6 and Appendix A.5.

M1.justification: The three-head quantile network, finite-difference density weights, weighted fine-tuning, clipping/mixing, and rectified-score conformalization are retained. Algorithm 2's use of τ = 1−α is a notation change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same eight datasets: Bike, Diamond, Gas Turbine, Naval, SGEMM, Superconductivity, Transcoding, and WEC. Their represented tasks and data coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparator sets remain unchanged, including Split, PLCP, Gaussian Scoring, CQR, RCP, ALD variants, and RCP-MultiHead. Updated citations do not introduce different comparison methods.

E3.justification: Appendix A.2 changes the stated PLCP configuration for the main tables from G=50 to G=20, reversing the supplementary designation. The unchanged main-table numbers already match the appendix's G=20 results, indicating a reported-setting correction rather than evidence of rerunning experiments.

E4.justification: The ALD and multihead comparisons, clipping/mixing ablations, and bandwidth sensitivity results remain unchanged. The expanded discussion and additional main-text table introduce no new supplementary analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report 20 Monte Carlo repetitions and mean±standard deviation. No repeated-run, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-testing practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical values in corresponding main and appendix result tables are identical. v5's added Table 4 redisplays selected L2-ERT results already present in v4's Appendix Table 9; it supplies no new experimental outcomes.

T1.justification: Appendix B.2 removes the erroneous factor 1/2 from the final quadratic term in Equation 45, restoring consistency with Proposition 3.4. Appendix B.3.3 changes the stated Lipschitz argument from s to g(x). The principal assumptions, theorems, and convergence rates are retained.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list soften 'directly minimize' MSCE to 'directly target' MSCE, more cautiously describing the retained surrogate optimization. The central methodological, theoretical, and empirical contributions otherwise remain the same.

C2.justification: Section 6.1 removes the inference that the multihead ablation supports substituting regressors beyond neural networks. Appendix C.1 also qualifies the assertion that Λ decreases as quantile estimation improves, replacing 'would' with 'may.'

D1.justification: The corrected PLCP group-count documentation makes the main comparison's configuration clearer. Network architectures, CPCP defaults, data processing, and code/data access otherwise remain unchanged; the relocated code link has the same destination.

R1.justification: Section 1.1 slightly strengthens its characterization of Kiyani et al.'s limitation, changing the rate description from 'as slowly as' to 'no faster than' O(n^-1/4). The cited work set is retained, with title and publication-detail updates.

P1.justification: Targeted rewrites expand the surrogate explanation, theoretical motivation, metrics discussion, and results interpretation. Grammar and terminology are edited, and an Impact Statement and Acknowledgement are added. The scientific section organization remains intact.

P2.justification: The main text and references switch from one column to two, with new running headers and extensively reflowed equations, algorithms, and tables. Figure 1 retains its diagram but gains an expanded caption. New main-text Table 4 repeats existing appendix results.

improvement.justification: v5 improves internal consistency through the Equation 45 correction and accurate PLCP configuration description. Expanded explanations and main-text access to retained L2-ERT results also aid understanding. These are limited gains: the method and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
